# Gentoolink Web Services

> Gentoolink Web Services helps small businesses get found in AI search - ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. Founded and operated by Ken McGonigal. Services are AI visibility audits, structured data implementation, Google Business Profile optimization, and ongoing GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) work for local businesses.

Gentoolink Web Services is a Canadian web services company based in Vanderhoof, British Columbia, serving small businesses across BC and beyond. The primary focus is AI search visibility - auditing and fixing the technical gaps that prevent businesses from appearing when customers ask AI tools for local recommendations. Ken McGonigal works directly with business owners; no handoffs or black-box processes. All prices are in Canadian dollars.

Contact: ken@gentoolinkwebservices.com | +1 (604) 218-7290

## Services

- [AI Visibility Audit](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/): $1,000 CAD - checks whether a business appears in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews; verifies Bing indexing, structured data validity, Google Business Profile completeness, and NAP consistency. Includes competitive comparison. Delivered as a plain-English PDF within 24 hours. The $1,000 fee is credited toward any implementation work.
- [AI Search Foundation Package](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/services.html): $2,500 CAD - full implementation of the fixes identified in the audit. JSON-LD schema markup, Bing Webmaster Tools setup, content restructuring for AI citation, FAQ sections, and Google Business Profile optimization. Verified against Google Rich Results Test and the major AI platforms. Delivered in 5-10 days.
- [GEO Retainer](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/services.html): two tiers. Lean GEO $150 CAD/month - ongoing AI visibility monitoring across ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, schema updates as services or hours change, and quarterly competitive reporting. Growth GEO $350 CAD/month - everything in Lean plus one new FAQ or service page per month optimized for AI citation, and priority support for schema errors or indexing issues.
- [Time & Money Audit](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/time-money-audit.html): $497 CAD - an in-person audit for Northern BC businesses (Vanderhoof, Fort St. James, Fraser Lake, Prince George). Finds the hours and dollars leaking out of quoting, invoicing, and follow-up, then delivers a written plan to fix it. The fee is credited toward the fixes.
- [Google Business Profile Management](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/google-business-profile-management.html): $250 CAD one-time tune-up (categories, NAP consistency, hours, photos, services, review replies, Q&A) or $150 CAD/month ongoing management. Done remotely, available Canada-wide.
- [AI Phone Receptionist](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/ai-phone-receptionist.html): $500 CAD setup plus $249 CAD/month. Answers every call 24/7, captures the caller's name, number and need, and texts the message through. Works with an existing phone number; no contract.
- [Website Hosting & Care Plans](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/website-hosting-care-plans.html): Managed hosting from $25 CAD/month (static) or $75 CAD/month (dynamic), security monitoring +$15 CAD/month. Care plans bundle hosting with edits: Lean $40 CAD/month, Growth $85 CAD/month. One-off changes from $50 CAD. Month to month, no contract.

Website design pricing: $800 CAD for a single-page landing site, $1,500 CAD for a typical 5-8 page local business website, $2,000 CAD for a product launch site. Online store +$500 CAD, logo and brand design +$500 CAD, copywriting from scratch +$300 CAD. Domain and DNS setup included with every build. Typical build time is 2-4 weeks. All prices are starting points; every project gets a firm fixed quote in writing before work begins, and is never billed hourly.

## Service Areas

Gentoolink Web Services is based in Vanderhoof, BC and serves communities along the Highway 16 corridor and the Cariboo. Website design and AI visibility work is delivered remotely; in-person visits, including the Time & Money Audit, are routine within about 90 minutes of Vanderhoof.

- [Web Design in Prince George, BC](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/web-design-prince-george.html): Website design and AI search visibility for Prince George, the largest and most competitive market in the service area. About one hour east of Vanderhoof on Highway 16.
- [Web Design in Vanderhoof, BC](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/web-design-vanderhoof.html): Home base. Ken McGonigal lives in Vanderhoof and is a member of the Vanderhoof Chamber of Commerce. In-person work is standard here.
- [Web Design in Fort St. James, BC](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/web-design-fort-st-james.html): Website design and AI visibility for Fort St. James, a visitor-driven town near Stuart Lake. About 45 minutes north of Vanderhoof on Highway 27.
- [Web Design in Fraser Lake, BC](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/web-design-fraser-lake.html): Website design and AI visibility for Fraser Lake, about 40 minutes west of Vanderhoof on Highway 16.
- [Web Design in Burns Lake, BC](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/web-design-burns-lake.html): Website design and AI visibility for Burns Lake and the Lakes District, about an hour and 15 minutes west of Vanderhoof.
- [Web Design in Quesnel, BC](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/web-design-quesnel.html): Website design and AI visibility for Quesnel and the Cariboo, roughly two hours south of Vanderhoof via Prince George.

## Websites by Industry

Small business websites start at $2,500 CAD and are typically live in 2-4 weeks, with structured data included rather than sold as an add-on. Final pricing depends on scope. Each industry page includes a free live demo site.

- [Restaurant Website Design](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/restaurant-website-design.html): Mobile-readable menus (not PDFs), accurate hours marked up as structured data, and weekly specials updatable by email.
- [Plumber Website Design](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/plumber-website-design.html): Built for urgent searches - tap-to-call, explicit emergency availability, and service areas encoded per town.
- [Electrician Website Design](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/electrician-website-design.html): Separate paths for residential service calls and commercial contract work, with licensing and project types stated explicitly.
- [Pizza Shop Website Design](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/pizza-shop-website-design.html): Fast-loading menus and pricing, tap-to-order, and reduced dependence on delivery platforms that take a cut of every order.
- [Church Website Design](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/church-website-design.html): Service times marked up for search and AI, written for first-time visitors rather than existing members.
- [Auto Repair Website Design](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/auto-repair-website-design.html): Trust-led design - real shop photos, named staff, and transparent explanations of how pricing works.
- [Dentist Website Design](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/dentist-website-design.html): Leads with new-patient availability and insurance details, and addresses dental anxiety directly.
- [Salon Website Design](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/salon-website-design.html): Gallery-led layout with one-tap booking into whatever system the salon already uses.
- [Landscaping Website Design](https://gentoolinkwebservices.com/landscaping-website-design.html): Before-and-after portfolio plus year-round service listings that maintain visibility through the off season.
